summary: cisco.ios deprecations: password in ios_bgp_address_family neighbors (use password_options), many ios_bgp_global attributes, and the legacy ios_linkagg and ios_lldp modules.
questions: How should I set BGP neighbor passwords in ios_bgp_address_family?

answer_card.title: cisco.ios BGP and legacy module deprecations
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ios_bgp_address_family`: neighbor `password` is deprecated. Use `password_options`.
- `ios_bgp_global`: deprecated attributes include `aggregate_address`, `bestpath`, `inject_map`, `distribute_list`, `password`, `route_map` and others.
- The legacy `ios_linkagg` and `ios_lldp` modules are deprecated.
